'''Zel N'got''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] being who lived on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during which he served as a spy for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he lived in the [[Residential District (Jorra)|Residential District]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]].<ref name="CotG" />
